source: Google Sheets Workout Generator (Audited - Single Primary + Synergist Secondaries)

workouts.name: Strength Quads
workouts.comments: 4 Exercise, 3 sets. 2 super sets. 2 exercises to burn out twice at the end
8 exersizes. 30 sec set, 30 sec rest, 20 sec set, 20 sec rest, etc. 60 sec rest between different exercises
5 Exercise, 10 reps (per side) down to 1 back up to 10

workouts.name: 6 Excercise Pyramid
workouts.comments: 30 seconds of one exercise. 10 sec transition between exercises. 60 sec rest at the end of each set. Add one exercise per set up to 6, then drop one exercise until 1 at the last round

workouts.name: 8x8 Duos
workouts.comments: Duos. 8 reps per exercise. 8 min per round. As many sets as you can do. No rest between exercises.

workouts.name: 5 Constant 5 Change (40/20)
workouts.comments: (First 3 exercises that get auto generated are the constants). 3 rounds of 6 unique exersices with 10 total sets. 5 excersizes are the same for 3 rounds. Each round gets their own unique constant exercise. That exersize gets repeated 5 times interspersed with the other exercises.
